title: GitHub contribution calendar snapshot (schema_version 1)
description: Written by scripts/fetch_contributions.py, read by scripts/render_heatmap_svg.py. The Python rules in scripts/contrib_data.py are authoritative; this file is documentation for editors and other tools.

updated_at.description: UTC time the day data last changed (not the last time the fetch ran).

as_of.description: UTC date of the fetch that produced the data; used for the current-streak rule.

reported_total.description: The 'N contributions in the last year' figure GitHub reports, or null if absent.

days.description: One entry per calendar day, ascending, contiguous (no gaps or duplicates).

count.description: null when the source did not give an exact count; statistics are then withheld.

level.description: GitHub's own intensity level 0-4 (fallback: quartiles of the busiest day).
